name: Southpaw Furniture Co
old_description: Solid hardwood furniture expertly handcrafted in our 5,000 sq ft workshop and delivered nationwide – our furniture is built to last a lifetime. If you are looking to make your house feel like a home you are in the right place.
about:
Southpaw Furniture Co operates from Sturtevant, Wisconsin, as a family-owned shop that began as a garage startup before expanding into a full-time manufacturing operation. The company does not disclose a founding year, but its about page describes the venture growing from a passion project into a dedicated facility.

The company handcrafts solid hardwood furniture—including custom dining tables, kitchen islands, side tables, and cabinetry—in a 5,500-square-foot facility equipped with a 400-square-foot spray booth. Multiple full-time employees build each piece using prime-grade hardwoods such as walnut and white oak, overseeing every step from design through finish application.

Southpaw serves residential and commercial customers nationwide, shipping completed pieces directly to homes and businesses. Clients collaborate on custom designs, and the shop sends physical stain samples on real wood so buyers can evaluate color in their own lighting. Reviews highlight projects ranging from dining tables to custom drawer inserts and pull-outs for kitchen islands.

The founders started the business to counter disposable furniture trends, committing to prime-grade materials and modern designs that blend form and function. The company emphasizes personalized service, sustainability, and integrity as core values, aiming to create pieces that anchor rooms for decades rather than seasons.
